notes: Printer Bot 3.2.0-beta.8 is a prerelease, a test version of 3.2.0 that can have mistakes; it reaches you only with Try prerelease versions on. The pictures of a message on a 4 x 6 in card in black and white now get the picture style; they printed like text. A sticker printer whose tape is left to it is asked for its tape before a receipt waits for its turn, so its answer holds up no other printer. The dock refuses a sticker printer address that Printer Bot cannot use at once, and says so under it. On a card or a sticker, a picture that failed a moment ago prints [image] where the pictures go. Thermal printer takes a sticker printer's card back to its roll, and the dock is faster with many printers and rules. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. A Printer Bot older than 2.5.0 needs one first (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart. The full list of changes is in the release notes of 3.2.0-beta.8 on GitHub.
